name: HighlightTA (Neon One)
assessment: Yes. Candidates report a hands-on technical project as part of the interview process, where you are given sample data to actually import into Neon One's CRM. This is described directly as reflecting what the job entails day to day.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
 Education Minimum: Not stated in posting. The role is built around demonstrated skills rather than a specific degree requirement.
 Required Experience:
1 to 2 years of hands-on data migration experience, including data translation and import processes
A track record of strong customer service
 Preferred Experience:
Nonprofit industry experience
Experience working in a SaaS environment
 Required Skills:
Advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills
Meticulous attention to detail for data accuracy
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability
Highly developed written and verbal communication
Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills
 Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
Someone with hands-on data migration or data cleanup experience who is very comfortable in Excel
People who like detail-oriented, investigative work, finding what is wrong in a spreadsheet and fixing it
Participants who want contract or project-based work rather than a long-term permanent position
Anyone interested in the nonprofit technology space
Not a Good Fit for:
Participants who need guaranteed long-term employment and traditional benefits
Anyone without prior data migration or advanced Excel experience, since this is a real, specific skill requirement
People who prefer verbal, phone-based work over written documentation and spreadsheet analysis
 Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Data migration
CRM implementation
Data validation
Excel data analysis
Data mapping
Pre-migration audit
Post-migration reconciliation
Salesforce
SaaS implementation
Nonprofit technology
notes:
This is a contract role through a staffing agency, not direct Neon One employment. Set that expectation clearly with participants before they apply, since the lack of guaranteed long-term work and standard benefits is a real difference from most other entries in the database.

Some candidates have reported a disjointed experience after the offer stage, citing communication gaps and a lack of urgency from HighlightTA specifically, separate from Neon One itself. Worth mentioning so a participant is not caught off guard if follow-up after an offer feels slow. 
The technical project during the interview is the real test here. A participant should walk in expecting to actually demonstrate their Excel and data cleanup skills live, not just talk about them.
Career Pathway: Data Migration Consultant → Senior Data Migration Consultant → Implementation Consultant → Senior Implementation Manager → Director of Client Implementation
other:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
 The process runs through HighlightTA rather than Neon One directly. It typically starts with an initial screening call with a HighlightTA recruiter, followed by an interview with two Neon One Implementation Managers. Next comes a hands-on technical project where you import sample data into the actual CRM, which mirrors the real job. A final interview reviews that project and covers company culture questions
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
